announcements.title: Urgent: School Closure — Heavy Rainfall Warning
announcements.excerpt: Due to severe weather conditions forecast for tomorrow, the school will remain closed on Thursday, June 5th.
announcements.body:
Dear Students, Parents, and Staff,

Following advice from the Rwanda Meteorological Agency regarding heavy rainfall and possible flooding in the region, EduBright Academy will be closed on Thursday, June 5th, 2026.

Key Information

  • All scheduled classes, exams, and activities are postponed.
  • Online learning materials will be shared via the student portal by 8:00 AM.
  • The rescheduled timetable will be communicated by Friday morning.

We prioritize the safety of our entire school community. Please stay safe and monitor official weather updates.
announcements.author: Dr. Marie Uwimana

announcements.title: End-of-Term Examination Schedule — Term 2, 2026
announcements.excerpt: The complete examination timetable for Term 2 is now available. All students must confirm their registration by June 10.
announcements.body:
The End-of-Term 2 examinations will run from June 16 to June 27, 2026. All students are expected to be present 30 minutes before their scheduled exam.

Important Dates

  • June 10 — Registration confirmation deadline
  • June 14 — Study day (no classes)
  • June 16 — Examinations begin
  • June 27 — Last examination day

Students with special accommodations should contact the academic office by June 8.
announcements.author: Mr. Patrick Habimana

announcements.title: Annual Cultural Day — June 21, 2026
announcements.excerpt: Celebrate Rwanda's rich heritage at our Annual Cultural Day. Students are encouraged to wear traditional attire.
announcements.body:
EduBright Academy's Annual Cultural Day will take place on Saturday, June 21, 2026 from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM on the school grounds.

Activities Include

  • Traditional dance performances by student groups
  • Art exhibition showcasing student artwork
  • Traditional food stalls and cooking demonstrations
  • Guest speakers on Rwandan history and culture
announcements.author: Ms. Alice Mukandayisenga

announcements.title: Liberation Day Holiday — School Closed July 4th
announcements.excerpt: In observance of Liberation Day, EduBright Academy will be closed on Friday, July 4, 2026.
announcements.body: EduBright Academy will be closed on Friday, July 4, 2026 in observance of Rwanda's Liberation Day.
announcements.author: Dr. Marie Uwimana

announcements.title: Library Hours Extended for Exam Season
announcements.excerpt: The school library will remain open until 8:00 PM on weekdays during the examination period.
announcements.body: To support students during the upcoming examination period, the EduBright Library will extend its hours from June 10 to June 27, 2026.
announcements.author: Mrs. Josée Uwera

announcements.title: New STEM Laboratory Opens September 2026
announcements.excerpt: A state-of-the-art STEM laboratory funded through a partnership with a technology NGO will open at the start of Term 1.
announcements.body: We are thrilled to announce that EduBright Academy's new STEM Laboratory will be officially inaugurated at the beginning of Term 1, September 2026.
announcements.author: Mr. Jean-Claude Nzabanita
